slot.brief: Direct integration by parts of a simple product (polynomial × exponential/trig); one application suffices.

stem: Evaluate the integral by parts: $\displaystyle \int xe^x\,dx$.

verdicts.working: Using integration by parts, ∫ xe^x dx = xe^x - ∫ e^x dx = e^x(x-1)+C.

working:
$u=x,\quad dv=e^x\,dx$
$\displaystyle \int xe^x\,dx=xe^x-\int e^x\,dx=e^x(x-1)+C$ Independent check: Using integration by parts, ∫ xe^x dx = xe^x - ∫ e^x dx = e^x(x-1)+C.
solution:
Using integration by parts, take $u=x$ and $dv=e^x\,dx$, so $du=dx$ and $v=e^x$.
$$\int xe^x\,dx=xe^x-\int e^x\,dx=e^x(x-1)+C$$
